cases.name: Jessica Lynn Winters
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Jessica had a fierce spirit that guided her to change the world. She was a strong activist, championing organic foods, feeding the homeless, and rescuing animals. Her strength and courage touched the lives of everyone she knew. She acted as a best friend, protector, and mother to her two younger sisters. She spent her days caring for her family, helping others, and spoiling her nieces and nephew."
